summary: A mobile cafeteria tray-return trolley: a stainless frame of four square uprights with top and bottom rails… joints castor_fl_swivel, castor_fl_wheel, castor_fr_swivel, castor_fr_wheel, castor_bl_swivel, castor_bl_wheel, …; options trays, load.
